title: Code2Video-Compass: A Comprehensive Benchmark for General-Purpose Code-Based Video Generation across T2V, I2V, and V2V
title_zh: Code2Video-Compass：面向通用基于代码的视频生成的跨文生视频、图生视频与视频转视频综合基准

paragraphs.en: 研究者推出Code2Video-Compass基准，覆盖文生视频、图生视频和视频转视频三种模式，系统评测基于代码的视频生成能力。 Code-based video generation offers fine-grained control, targeted editing, and component reuse compared with direct video generation. This approach requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to translate visual and temporal requirements into executable programs that produce complete videos. However, existing code-based benchmarks primarily target specialized tasks, leaving complete video creation across diverse creative categories and input modalities insufficiently evaluated. We introduce Code2Video-Compass, a general-purpose benchmark for code-based video generation across text-to-video (T2V), image-to-video (I2V), and video-to-video (V2V) settings. Code2Video-Compass comprises 2,104 tasks spanning 10 categories, 24 subtypes, and three complexity dimensions covering construction, dynamic animation, and state dependency. It combines tasks curated from textual instructions and visual references with corresponding T2V, I2V, and V2V tasks derived from complete professional and user-created videos. We propose a dual-level evaluation framework combining 12 objective metrics and five subjective metrics. Objective evaluation covers operational performance, video quality, text-video alignment, and reference fidelity, while subjective evaluation uses an MLLM judge to evaluate instruction following and holistic video quality. Extensive evaluation of 15 recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs from nine families reveals that even leading models face challenges in reliably generating high-quality complete videos aligned with textual and visual requirements, with performance generally declining as construction, dynamic animation, and state-dependency complexity increases. We anticipate that Code2Video-Compass will advance reliable, coherent, and controllable code-based video generation and inspire broader progress in programmatic visual creation.
paragraphs.zh: 研究者推出Code2Video-Compass基准，覆盖文生视频、图生视频和视频转视频三种模式，系统评测基于代码的视频生成能力。与直接视频生成相比，基于代码的视频生成提供了细粒度控制、针对性编辑和组件复用。 这种方法要求多模态大语言模型（MLLM）将视觉和时间需求翻译成可执行的程序，以生成完整的视频。 然而，现有的基于代码的基准主要针对专门任务，对跨多样创意类别和输入模态的完整视频创作评估不足。 我们提出Code2Video-Compass，这是一个面向基于代码的视频生成的通用基准，涵盖文生视频（T2V）、图生视频（I2V）和视频转视频（V2V）三种设置。 Code2Video-Compass包含2,104个任务，涵盖10个类别、24个子类型，以及覆盖构建、动态动画和状态依赖三个复杂度维度。 它将来自文本指令和视觉参考的任务，与从完整的专业视频和用户创作视频衍生的对应T2V、I2V和V2V任务相结合。 我们提出一个双层评估框架，结合12项客观指标和五项主观指标。 客观评估涵盖运行性能、视频质量、文本-视频一致性和参考保真度，而主观评估使用一个MLLM评判器来评估指令遵循和视频整体质量。 对来自九个系列的15个近期专有和开放权重MLLM的广泛评估表明，即使是领先的模型也难以可靠地生成符合文本和视觉要求的高质量完整视频，且性能通常随着构建、动态动画和状态依赖复杂度的增加而下降。 我们期待Code2Video-Compass能够推动可靠、连贯且可控的基于代码的视频生成，并激发程序化视觉创作领域更广泛的进展。
